info.title: Web Scraper Public API
info.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Create keys in the dashboard under API keys. Jobs are asynchronous: create, poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`, then read results. Errors always have the shape `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.description: Creates a scrape job. By default returns immediately (202) with status `queued`/`running`: poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until the status is terminal, then fetch `GET /jobs/{id}/results`. With `?wait=true` the request blocks until the page is done and returns 200 with the job and the page content inline (a failed scrape also returns 200, with `job.status = failed` and `job.error`).

project_id.description: Project to file the job under. Default: your oldest project ("Default project").

timeout_ms.description: Per-page timeout. Default 30000; server max applies.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the scrape finishes (up to timeout_ms + 30s) and return the job with the page content inline (HTTP 200). If it doesn't finish in time you get the usual 202 + job to poll.

200.description: Returned by POST /scrape?wait=true when the job finished in time.

schema.title: ScrapeSyncResponse
schema.description: Returned by POST /scrape?wait=true when the job finished in time.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous crawl. Progress and page counts are reported on the job; pages appear under `/jobs/{id}/results` as they complete.

project_id.description: Project to file the job under. Default: your oldest project ("Default project").

timeout_ms.description: Per-page timeout. Default 30000; server max applies.

max_depth.description: Link depth from the start URL. Default 3.

include_patterns.description: Regexes matched against the URL path; only matching pages are crawled.

exclude_patterns.description: Regexes matched against the URL path; matching pages are skipped.

allowed_domain.description: Confine the crawl to this domain (start host or a parent of it). Default: start host.

allow_subdomains.description: Also follow links to subdomains of allowed_domain. Default false.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job

get.description: Paginated page results. Failed pages are included with `success: false` and an `error`. Set `include_content=true` to inline markdown/html/text.

get.summary: Download all results of a job
get.description: Streams every result with content, as JSON Lines (default) or a JSON array.
`format` = markdown | html | text | json (json includes metadata and every stored format).

get.summary: List your projects (to find a project_id)
